text: minutes a day. That's all it takes to start understanding your salah.
You've probably heard Arabic takes years… because most courses start with grammar.
Rafiq starts with the words you already say. In your first week: the twenty words you say most in salah. That's more than half of every four-rakʿah prayer, before the surah.
Every word comes with audio and a picture… and comes back just before you'd forget it.
Then you keep going: every word of your salah, ten short surahs, and seven hundred and eighty-five words in thirty-six real conversations.
Ten minutes a day. Free for seven days, no card. Which part of your salah do you want to understand first? Tell me in the comments!
